  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days for high sentiment volatility or sharp price spikes.",
    "Cap upward overshoots above +10% of recent 7-day average to prevent overreaction.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast deviates >5% from 30-day moving average, adjust toward it.",
    "Reduce forecast sensitivity to recent highs when sentiment is negative — avoid chasing momentum.",
    "Increase forecast volatility when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to reflect bullish momentum.",
    "For sentiment = 0.25, apply a 5% downward bias to prevent overestimation of bullish signals."
  ]
